task: transcribe scanned / faxed / handwritten archive pages
hardware: AMD Token Factory (shared endpoints on AMD GPUs)
note: CER = character error rate vs. the generator's reference transcription (lower is better), after removing Markdown syntax and the [stamp]/[handwritten note]/[illegible] markers; it counts reading order. Word F1 = order-insensitive share of words read correctly (higher is better). Same page images for every model; chat models get CROMO's production transcription prompt. Latency is per page on the shared Token Factory (it includes queueing on AMD's side). Small samples per page type: see pages_by_kind.
